# IntraWeb Technologies

> AI-first product and automation studio for small and mid-sized businesses. We build workflow automation, AI integrations, and web systems that replace manual operational work.

IntraWeb Technologies LLC is based in Towaco, NJ and serves SMBs across the NJ/NYC metro and remotely nationwide. Founded by John Schibelli, a senior engineer and AI systems architect with 15+ years of experience.

## Core Services

- AI Workflow Diagnostic: Structured operational assessment that maps manual processes, identifies automation opportunities, and delivers a prioritized roadmap the client keeps.
- Workflow Automation: End-to-end automation for lead intake, onboarding, proposals, invoicing, and reporting. Built on n8n with HubSpot and Stripe integration. 62 workflows currently in production.
- AI Integration: Embedding AI models, retrieval workflows, and prompt guardrails into existing products and operations stacks.
- E-commerce Automation: Full order lifecycle automation — abandoned cart recovery, order processing, fulfillment, shipping, returns, post-purchase retention, and operations reporting.
- Website Development: Performance-engineered websites and SaaS platforms built with automation integration from day one.
- MVP and SaaS Platform Build: Full product engineering from validated first release to production-hardened platform.
- Retainers: Ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and optimization for all systems built by IntraWeb.

## Key Facts

- 62 automation workflows in production across 8 operational categories
- Entry point for all engagements: AI Workflow Diagnostic
- No hourly billing — all engagements structured as fixed deliverables, retainers, or value outcomes
- NJ-based, available for on-site engagements in NY metro
- All systems include post-launch retainer coverage
